correctness.rationale: Integral Lefschetz supplies H^0,H^1,H^2,H^3 of the n-dimensional smooth quadric intersection for every n>=4. The projective involution fixes its primitive H^2 generator. For a free C2 quotient the Cartan–Leray E2 terms in total degree three all vanish; the only degree-two survivors are Z and Z/2 and the extension splits. Finite étale descent of H^1(O)=H^2(O)=0 and the exponential exact sequence yield Pic=H^2 and zero analytic H^2(O*) (and thus zero algebraic Brauer). The anticanonical holomorphic residue transforms by (-1)^(n+1)=-1, identifying the nontrivial canonical 2-torsion. The argument treats all even n>=4 and excludes dimension two.

value.rationale: Brauer groups are natural obstruction-theoretic invariants at the center of the recent work, and the exact vanishing for this explicit infinite-dimensional family was not tabulated in the inspected literature. The uniform integral cohomological calculation is stronger than a single example, isolates a sharp dimension-two boundary (classical Enriques surfaces have Br=Z/2), and clarifies a geometric difference between Calabi–Yau-cover and hyper-Kähler-cover Enriques manifolds. These motivations precede the computation; no claim of a new general spectral-sequence theorem is made.
